text: おれたちの　ポケモンは　うみに　でた　ときに　じぶんで　とった　もの　ばかり　だぜ

structure.jp: おれたちの　ポケモンは
うみに　でた　ときに
structure.en: when we went out to sea

structure.jp: じぶんで　とった　もの　ばかり　だぜ
structure.en: are all ones we caught ourselves

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: じぶんで　とった　もの
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a noun tells you which one is meant. じぶんで　とった　もの = 'ones we caught ourselves'.

patterns.name: 〜ときに
patterns.span: うみに　でた　ときに
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by ときに means 'at the time when' that happened. うみに　でた　ときに = 'when we went out to sea'.

patterns.name: 〜ばかり
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a noun means 'nothing but' that thing. とった　もの　ばかり = 'nothing but ones we caught'.
